scope: Controlled follow-up to August WebShop 3B experiments
gpu_policy: Do not launch or allocate GPUs from this thread; deployment is owned by the user's other thread.

common_design.student: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, same pinned revision across arms
common_design.researcher: Self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from deployment thread; freeze weight hash and serving version before any arm
common_design.base_reward: explicit train.reward_from_score=false; retrospective August flag was not serialized
common_design.evaluation: No Skill; fixed held-out tasks, temperature=0.6, n=3; freeze decoding seeds and full task IDs
common_design.selection: Choose any tuning on disjoint dev tasks; report fixed step 200 and predeclared learning-curve area, not best test checkpoint
common_design.resources: Same allocated student GPU count, model dtype, research concurrency, and timeouts across paired arms; record any change from August
common_design.budget: Record environment episodes, researcher tokens, GPU-hours and wall time; researcher experiments add cost beyond student rollouts

arms.purpose: Isolate inclusive-mean versus LOO baseline scale without Skill
Primary one-factor fallback-grouping ablation against P0
Optional reward-objective ablation; partial score changes the objective and must not be described as merely denser supervision

required_evidence: Launch manifest, source hashes, weight hashes, dataset hashes and exact task ordering
Per-task complete rollout groups, assigned arm and advantage arm, missing/overflow doc flags and fallback reason
Skill text, generating experiments, policy version, independent verification of task-specific claims
Training binary reward and score side by side, scalar advantages, valid-token masks, truncation, actor update marker
No-Skill per-task evaluation outcomes; task-cluster paired confidence intervals and separate training-seed variation
Do not treat 60-step smoke/pilot as post-retirement evidence for T=133
Report if no fallbacks occur: P1 then cannot test the targeted fallback mechanism
current_result: No new model-training comparison has been run in this task after the user's GPU restriction. CPU checks establish mechanism behavior only.
